blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reasoning about human-object interaction from RGB cameras is important for gaming, VR environments, and robot learning. Yet 4D reconstruction from a monocular RGB camera is challenging, especially when articulated hands are involved. Prior full-body works neglect hands during reconstruction, causing them to penetrate into, or float from the object. We present HARI4D, a hand-articulation-aware method for reconstructing spatially and temporally consistent 4D human-object interaction from monocular RGB video. We introduce a history-aware object tracker that provides robust and stable tracking. Based on these tracks, we improve the interaction configuration through coarse-to-fine reasoning that follows the order of object manipulation: ReachNet first brings the full body and arms to the object during contact, and TouchNet then finalizes hand articulation according to temporal context and local object geometry. On ARCTIC, unseen in training, our method reduces the object error by 56% and improves hand contact F1 from 0.866 to 0.921 over prior art. Our method recovers accurate full body-object interaction with coherent hand articulations and applies to online videos. Our code and pretrained models will be released.
blocks.zh: 通过RGB相机对人与对象的相互作用进行解释,对于游戏,VR环境,机器人学习都很重要. 然而,用单相机进行4D重建具有挑战性,特别是在涉及手伸口的情况下。 之前的全体工作在重建过程中忽略了手,导致手被穿入或从物体上浮出. 我们提出HARI4D,一种手动渲染-感知方法,用于从单相光的RGB视频中重建空间和时间上一致的4D人-物体相互作用. 我们引入了一个具有历史认识的物体跟踪器,提供有力而稳定的跟踪. 基于这些轨道,我们通过粗细到细的推理来改进交互配置,这些推理遵循物体操纵的顺序: ReachNet在接触时首先将全身和手臂带入物体,TouchNet再根据时间上下文和局部物体几何来完成手语表达. 在ACTIC上,我们的方法将对象错误减少56%,并将手接触F1从0.866提高到0.921,优于以前的艺术. 我们的方法恢复了准确的全身-物体交互 与连贯的手语,并适用于在线视频。 我们的代码和预先训练过的模型将被释放.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Reconstructing human–object interactions from ordinary RGB videos can turn demonstrations into rich supervision for embodied agents. Beyond identifying which object moves, a robot must understand how the body approaches it, the arm positions the wrist, and the fingers establish and maintain a grasp. Metric 4D reconstruction of this process can support robot learning from human demonstrations [ 86 , 21 , 67 ] , realistic digital humans for games [ 16 ] , and interactive virtual and augmented reality content [ 42 ] .
blocks.zh: 重新构建普通RGB视频的人类-对象互动,可将演示转化为对内含物剂的丰富监督. 除了辨别出哪个物体在移动外,机器人还必须了解身体是如何接近它的,手臂将手腕摆出,手指建立并保持了抓取. 这个过程的Metric 4D重建可以支持机器人从人类的演示中学习[86, 21, 67],为游戏提供现实的数码人类[16],以及互动的虚拟和增强现实内容[42].

blocks.en: Recent full-body human–object interaction (HOI) methods have progressively relaxed their assumptions on the manipulated object: from template-based reconstruction [ 69 , 84 ] , to reconstructing unseen instances within specific categories [ 72 , 9 ] , and finally to category-agnostic reconstruction [ 73 , 64 ] . Yet these methods represent the hands without detailed hand articulation, precisely where physical manipulation happens. Conversely, hand–object methods recover articulated hands from images [ 19 , 79 , 8 , 36 ] or videos [ 20 , 80 , 13 , 60 ] , but typically leave out the supporting full-body pose. This separation is limiting: a plausible object manipulation not only depends on hand and wrist poses but also should be supported by the arm and full body.
blocks.zh: 最近的人体-对象相互作用(HOI)方法逐渐放松了对被操纵对象的假设:从基于模板的重建[69,84],到在特定类别内重建未见实例[72,9],最后到不可知类别重建[73,64]。 然而,这些方法代表的是手,没有详细的手相通,正是在实际操作的地方。 反之,手-物体方法从图像[19、79、8、36]或视频[20、80、13、60]中取回手,但通常不使用支持的全身姿势。 这种分离是有限的:一种可能的物体操纵不仅取决于手和手腕的姿势,而且还应当由手臂和全身支撑.

blocks.en: Bridging these two scales is particularly difficult in monocular video. Depth ambiguity makes the relative placement of the human and object underconstrained, while their motion causes persistent and changing occlusion. The evidence also becomes progressively weaker toward the point of contact: the body occupies a large image region, but the wrist and fingers may span only a few pixels and are often hidden by the object during manipulation. A successful method must therefore reason jointly about body motion, object motion, and hand articulation, while using temporal context to recover what is invisible in individual frames.
blocks.zh: 在单人视频中,缩小这两个尺度尤其困难。 深度模糊使得人和物体的相对位置受到不足的制约,而它们的运动则导致持续的和不断变化的被隔离. 证据也逐渐向接触点变弱:身体占据了较大的图像区域,但手腕和手指可能只会跨出几个像素,在被操纵时经常被物体所隐藏. 因此,一种成功的方法必须共同说明身体运动、物体运动和手发表达的理由,同时利用时间背景来恢复个别框架所看不见的东西。

blocks.en: We introduce H and- A rticulation Aware 4D R econstruction of Human–Object I nteraction (HARI4D), a category-agnostic method for reconstructing metric 4D full-body HOI with articulated hands from a monocular RGB video. Our key idea is to follow the natural hierarchy of manipulation: the body first approaches the object, the arm then positions the wrist, and the fingers finally form the grasp. We initialize the human pose and metric object shape with complementary foundation models, and obtain a stable object anchor with our history-conditioned object pose tracker. We then refine the interaction in a coarse to fine manner. ReachNet uses local object geometry, image-based contact cues, and temporal context to adjust the body, arms, and wrists. Given this holistic reconstruction, TouchNet reasons over the local object surface through time to refine wrist orientation and hand articulation. Because both refiners operate on local geometric relations rather than object-specific features, the resulting system generalizes to unseen objects, see Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们引入 H 和 - 一个有知觉的 4D R e Construction of Human - Object I nteraction(HARI4D),这是用从一款单相机的 RGB 视频中清晰的手进行 4D 全身HOI 重建的一类不可知论方法. 我们的关键思想是遵循操纵的自然等级:身体先接近物体,然后手臂将手腕放入,手指最后形成抓取. 我们以互补的基础模型初始化人类的姿势和公尺物体形状,并用我们的历史条件物体来获得稳定的物体锚地. 然后我们以粗略的方式完善互动。 ReachNet使用局部对象几何,以图像为基础的接触提示,以及时间上下文来调整身体,手臂和手腕. 鉴于这种整体重建,TouchNet在一段时间内在局部物体表面提出完善手腕取向和手相通的理由. 由于两个精炼器都运行在局部几何关系上而不是对象特有特征上,因此所形成的系统被概括到看不见的物体上,参见图1.

blocks.en: We evaluate HARI4D on ARCTIC [ 12 ] and BEHAVE [ 3 ] . Compared with prior art CARI4D, our method reduces combined Chamfer distance by 42.9%, while improving hand-contact F1 from 0.866 to 0.921 on ARCTIC. On BEHAVE, it reduces combined Chamfer distance by 11.8%, human acceleration error by 57.8%, and object acceleration error by 54.0%. Our ablations further show that our tracker substantially improves object tracking, while ReachNet brings better body-object arrangement and TouchNet improves local hand-object interaction geometry.
blocks.zh: 我们评价HARI4D在ARCTIC [12]和BEHAVE [3]。 与之前的艺术 CARI4D 相比,我们的方法将Chamfer 的结合距离减少了42.9%,同时在 ARCTIC 上改进了手接触F1 从 0.866 到 0.921. 在BEHAVE上,它将Chamfer综合距离缩短了11.8%,人机加速度出错57.8%,物体加速度出错54.0%. 我们的活字进一步显示,我们的跟踪器大大改进了物体跟踪,而ReachNet则带来更好的物体-物体安排,TouchNet则改进了局部的手物体交互几何.

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are: • We present HARI4D, a category-agnostic method to reconstruct metric 4D full-body human–object interactions with articulated hands from monocular RGB video. • We introduce a history-conditioned object pose refiner that incorporates past motion into current pose reasoning, yielding more accurate and temporally stable object tracking under occlusion. • We propose a hierarchical interaction-reasoning framework comprising ReachNet for contact-aware body, arm, and wrist refinement and TouchNet for temporally consistent hand articulation refinement. Together with our tracker, they outperform prior work in reconstruction error on both ARCTIC and BEHAVE. Our code and pretrained models will be released.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的主要贡献是: 我们介绍HARI4D,一种可知性方法,用以重建公制4D全体人-物体相互作用,用单光光谱的RGB视频清晰的手进行。 我们引入了具有历史条件的物体外观精炼器,将过去的运动纳入目前的外观推理中,从而在隔离下产生更准确和时间稳定的物体跟踪。 我们建议建立一个分级的互动理由框架,包括接触意识身体、手臂和手腕精炼的ReachNet和手腕精炼的TouchNet。 它们与我们的追踪器一起,在ACTIC和BEHAVE的重建出错方面都比以前做得好。 我们的代码和预先训练过的模型将被释放.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 3D foundation models. Human mesh recovery now handles in-the-wild images [ 77 , 44 , 50 ] . Image-to-3D models generate object shape from a single image [ 5 , 87 , 66 ] , and pose estimators recover object pose from RGB or RGB-D input [ 63 , 26 ] . Single-image geometry models predict relative depth [ 58 , 76 ] or metric depth [ 59 , 48 , 49 , 24 ] , and reconstruction models recover whole scenes from multiple views [ 56 , 57 , 33 ] . While these methods show impressive performance in their respective goals, they do not reason about the relationship and interaction between components.
blocks.zh: 三维基础模型. 人类的网状恢复现在处理的就是被覆盖的图像[77,44,50]. 图像到3D模型从单个图像生成对象形状[5,87,66],并摆出从RGB或RGB-D输入中恢复对象外观[63,26]. 单相相相几何模型预测相对深度[58,76]或公尺深度[59,48,49,24],重建模型从多相视图中恢复了整个场景[56,57,33]. 虽然这些方法在各自的目标上表现出了令人印象深刻的表现,但它们并没有说明各组成部分之间的关系和相互作用。

blocks.en: Hand-object interaction and grasp modeling. Hands and hand-held objects have been reconstructed from single images [ 19 , 79 , 8 , 36 ] and from videos [ 20 , 80 , 13 , 60 ] , often down to finger articulation, but these methods leave out the body. Other works focus on the hand-object interaction itself using implicit fields, contact models and generative priors [ 22 , 34 , 81 ] that describe how a hand fits an object, ContactOpt [ 15 ] , TOCH [ 89 ] and GeneOH Diffusion [ 35 ] refine noisy hand poses or motion against the object, and GEARS [ 90 ] reasons about the local object geometry near each hand joint. These methods are successful in finding accurate finger articulations, but do not consider the full body motion which is critical to finding a plausible wrist position.
blocks.zh: 手-对象交互和抓取模型. 手和手持的物体是从单相相[19,79,8,36]和相片[20,80,13,60]中被重建而来,常被放入指外,但这些方法将身体排除在外. 其他作品则以手-对象相互作用本身为焦点,使用隐含字段,接触模型和基因前传[22,34,81]来描述一手如何与一物体相匹配,ContactOpt [15],TOCH [89]和GeneOH扩散[35]精细地对一物体产生或运动,以及GEARS[90]每个手关节附近局部物体几何的原因. 这些方法成功地找到了准确的指纹,但不考虑全身运动,这对于找到一个可信的手腕位置至关重要。

blocks.en: Full body human and interaction. Human-scene interaction reconstruction models the person with the surrounding geometry [ 18 , 82 ] or by recovering people and scenes together [ 38 , 37 , 7 ] . PhySIC [ 39 ] optimizes a body against a single reconstructed scene with contact and interpenetration terms, and GRAFT [ 83 ] uses a learned iterative refiner that probes the scene geometry around the body.
blocks.zh: 全身人和互动. 人与人与周围几何[18,82]或通过恢复人与场景一起重建[38,37,7]. PhySIC [39]对一具躯体进行优化,与单个被重建的场景相比,带有接触和互穿术语,而GRAFT [83] 使用一个有学识的迭代精炼器来探测尸体周围的场景几何.

blocks.en:
Single-image human-object interaction reconstruction [ 70 ] has been studied through template-based fitting [ 84 , 68 , 40 , 27 , 61 ] , template-free reconstruction [ 71 , 64 , 4 , 6 ] , mesh retrieval [ 9 , 11 ] , and learned interaction priors [ 1 ] . On video, VisTracker [ 69 ] tracks with a known template, InterTrack [ 72 ] removes the template while still being category bound. CARI4D [ 73 ] generalizes to unseen categories by building on foundation models, but it does not regress detailed finger articulation. Other works add an IMU on the object [ 85 ] , a physics simulator [ 21 ] , a moving camera [ 74 ] , lift 2D keypoints to world-space body and object motion [ 31 ] , or sparse head and wrist tracking [ 47 ] . HA-HOI [ 86 ] fuses hand estimates into the body and refines the wrists and fingers against the object by optimization, and GraspHOI [ 23 ] likewise optimizes the arms and fingers against the object surface, but from a single image.
Full-body motion [ 28 , 29 , 41 ] and grasping [ 2 ] have also been studied generatively [ 55 , 88 , 43 , 53 , 65 , 30 , 51 ] , synthesizing whole-body grasping motion, and GRIP [ 54 ] denoises the arms and synthesizes the fingers from a given body and object motion. Unlike HA-HOI and GraspHOI, which do heavy test time optimization, HARI4D refines the body, arms and hands with an efficient feedforward network.

blocks.en: Given an RGB video { I t } t = 1 T \{I_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} recorded by a monocular camera, our goal is to recover the metric 4D motion of a person and a rigid object, including the person’s articulated hands. We represent the person by SMPL-X [ 45 ] and the object by a mesh 𝒪 \mathcal{O} with a 6DoF pose ( R t , 𝝉 t ) ({R}_{t},\boldsymbol{\tau}_{t}) in every frame. In addition to the video, we take binary person and object masks, M t h M^{h}_{t} and M t o M^{o}_{t} respectively, as input.

blocks.en: This setting requires reasoning at two very different spatial scales. Full-body motion is supported by large image regions, whereas the wrist and fingers occupy few pixels and are frequently occluded when contact occurs. We therefore reconstruct the interaction hierarchically, mirroring the structure of manipulation: coarse body motion first brings a hand near the object, then the wrist and fingers establish the plausible grasp. We initialize the human and metric object in a common camera frame ( Sec. 3.1 ), obtain a stable object anchor with history-conditioned pose tracking ( Sec. 3.2 ), and finally refine the human against this fixed object from the body to the arms and articulated hands ( Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 这种设置需要在两个非常不同的空间尺度上进行推理. 全身运动由大图像区域所支持,而手腕和手指占据的像素很少,在接触时经常被被打入. 因此,我们按层次来重建相互作用,反映操纵的结构:粗糙的身体运动首先带来一只手靠近物体,再由手腕和手指来建立合理的把握. 我们以共同相机框架(第3.1节)初始化人和公尺物体,获得具有历史条件的姿势跟踪的稳定物体锚地(第3.2节),最后将人从身体到手臂和手伸展的这一固定物体加以精炼(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: We further reconstruct 3D object shape and its metric-scale that aligns with the human scale. Observing that foundation depth estimators tend to produce good relative geometry when hand and object are in contact, we hence use a contacting frame to estimate the metric-scale and pick another nearby frame to reconstruct the object. Specifically, we first find an interval of still frames where object does not move. Then, searching from either end of this interval towards its middle, we use HOI-DETR [ 10 ] to find frame A A , where the object is in contact with any hand and the hand depth overlaps with the object depth. The frame in this static interval with the largest object region visible is the rest frame B B . We use frame B B to reconstruct the canonical mesh using SAM 3D [ 5 ] , and estimate the metric-scale of the object with depth estimation from frame A A using FoundationPose [ 63 ] . For convenience, we denote the metric scaled object mesh as 𝒪 \mathcal{O} . More details on frame selection and scale estimation are provided in Sec. 6.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们进一步重建了与人类规模相匹配的三维物体形状及其度量尺度. 观察到地基深度估计器在接触手和物体时往往会产生良好的相对几何形状,因此我们使用一个相接相框来估计度量衡并选择另一个相邻相框来重建物体. 具体地说,我们首先找到物体不移动的静态框架的间隔. 然后,从这个间隔的任意一端向中间搜索,我们使用HOI-DETR [10] 找到框架 A ,其中对象与任何手相接,手深度与对象深度相重叠. 此静态相距中最显眼的天体区域为剩余相框 B. 我们使用B帧来重建用SAM 3D [5] 来重建犬网,并用A帧使用FoundationPose [63] 来估计该天体的度量尺度。 为方便起见,我们将测量对象网标为 O\ mathcal{O} 。 关于框架选择和规模估计的更详细情况见第6.1节。

blocks.en: Our reconstruction uses the object as an anchor for the subsequent human refinement. We add history conditioning with FiLM [ 46 ] to the FoundationPose [ 63 ] refiner and run the tracking with the fine-tuned model and a velocity-based Kalman filter. This combines current image evidence with tracked history motion, producing more stable and robust object tracking than vanilla FoundationPose.
blocks.zh: 我们的重建利用这个物体作为后来人类改良的锚地. 我们在FoundationPose [63]精炼器中添加了有FiLM [46]的历史调制,并用微调模型和一个以速度为基础的Kalman滤波器运行跟踪. 这结合了当前图像证据和有轨历史运动,产生了比"香草基金会"(vanilla Foundation Pose)更稳定和更坚固的物体跟踪.

blocks.en: FoundationPose refiner uses an image encoder to extract image feature which is then passed to rotation and translation prediction heads each consisting of one transformer encoder followed by one linear layer. This refiner sees only the current frame and the pose it starts from, not the motion that led there, so under occlusion or noisy depth it can jitter or produce a temporally inconsistent orientation.

blocks.en: 3.3 Hierarchical Interaction Enhancement
blocks.zh: 3.3 等级互动增强

blocks.en: Human estimation and object tracking alone do not produce a coherent 4D interaction trajectory. We address this with two learned refiners in a hierarchical way: ReachNet first adjusts the coarse body, arms, and wrist poses against the fixed object and TouchNet then improves the wrist orientation and hand articulation to form correct hand-object contacts. Both reason from local geometric relations and contact evidence from images.
blocks.zh: 仅靠人类估计和物体跟踪并不能产生连贯的4D相互作用轨迹. 我们用两个学习的精炼器来解决这个问题: ReachNet首先调整了粗体,手臂和手腕对固定物体的姿势;TouchNet则改进了手腕取向和手语来形成正确的手物接触. 这两种原因都来自当地的几何关系和图像的接触证据.

blocks.en: 3.3.1 ReachNet: body and wrist refinement
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 ReachNet:身体和手腕改进

blocks.en: The initial reconstruction can capture the overall interaction while still placing the human away from the object or penetrating it. We therefore introduce ReachNet, Re finement a round c ontact h ints, which leverages 3D proximity, image-based contact evidence, and temporal context to reason about the human-object relation at the coarse level of body, arm, and wrists. This contact-aware refinement encourages the reconstructed human to remain close to the object whenever supported by the observation.
blocks.zh: 最初的重建可以捕捉整体的相互作用,而同时又能将人从物体上移出或穿透. 因此,我们引入了ReachNet,Re finement a round c ontact h ints,它利用了3D相近,基于图像的接触证据,以及时间背景来解释人体,手臂和手腕等粗糙层面的人体与物体的关系. 这种接触意识的完善,鼓励被重建的人类在观察所支持的任何时候保持与物体相近.

blocks.en: Geometry sensing with contact hints. Let 𝐅 b \mathbf{F}_{b} and 𝐅 a \mathbf{F}_{a} denote the body and arm tokens, respectively. The body anchors comprise the pelvis and body joints, surface samples distributed over the torso, legs, and head, and patches along the arms. Each arm group contains anchors at the shoulder, elbow, and wrist, the finger joints and fingertips, a hand-summary anchor, and samples on the hand surface. For each human anchor 𝐩 i \mathbf{p}_{i} , we query its closest point 𝐪 i \mathbf{q}_{i} on the reconstructed object and the corresponding object-surface normal 𝐧 i \mathbf{n}_{i} . blocks.en: Datasets. We train our models on GRAB [ 52 ] and BEHAVE [ 3 ] datasets, while evaluation is performed on the ARCTIC [ 12 ] dataset and the BEHAVE [ 3 ] test set. As our method assumes a rigid object, on ARCTIC we select segments of at least 150 frames in which the object’s articulation, according to the ground truth, varies by at most 5 ∘ throughout the segment. We select two exocentric camera views for each segment, providing a total of 254 videos with 103,510 frames covering all 11 objects. On BEHAVE, we use the 62 test videos used in CARI4D [ 73 ] . The history-conditioned refiner is trained on renderings of GRAB [ 52 ] following [ 71 , 25 ] and real images of HO3D [ 17 ] . We train ReachNet on GRAB and BEHAVE and TouchNet on GRAB only as BEHAVE does not have accurate hands.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们用GRAB[52]和BEHAVE[3]数据集培训我们的模型,同时对ARCTIC[12]数据集和BEHAVE[3]测试集进行评价。 当我们的方法假设一个刚性物体时, 我们在ACTIC上选择了至少150个框架的片段, 根据地面的真理, 物体的表达在整个片段中最多有5个变化。 我们为每个片段选择两个外向相机视图,总共提供254个视频,103,510帧,覆盖所有11个物体. 在BEHAVE上,我们使用CARI4D使用的62个测试视频[73]. 以历史为条件的精炼器在[71,25]HO3D[17]的真实图像后,对GRAB[52]的渲染进行了培训. 我们用GRAB和BEHAVE和TouchNet来训练RachNet, 因为BEHAVE没有准确的手。

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol. Similar to the world-space metrics in [ 69 , 78 ] , we align the reconstructed human mesh with the GT mesh within each 300-frame window and apply the same transformation to the object before computing any metrics. When necessary, we convert the predicted or GT body models to SMPL-X. We report Chamfer distance (CD) and acceleration error as defined in CARI4D [ 73 ] . Following [ 62 ] , we evaluate contact using precision, recall, and F1-score. We additionally define three metrics for interaction quality: penetration, floating distance, and mean joint-to-object error (MJ2O). All three are evaluated only on frames in which the GT body is in contact with the object and are therefore grouped under “At contact” in the tables. Penetration and floating distance measure how much the body penetrates or floats above the object mesh, respectively. MJ2O measures the error between the predicted and GT signed distances to the object mesh at selected body joints. For ARCTIC, we use the hand joints and fingertips, whereas for BEHAVE, we use the body joints.
blocks.zh: 评估协议。 与[69,78]中的世界-空间度量衡类似,我们把重建后的人网与每个300个框架窗口内的GT网相配合,并在计算出任何度量衡之前对对象进行同样的转换. 必要时,我们将预测出或GT体型转换为SMPL-X. 我们报告CARI4D中定义的Chamfer距离(CD)和加速度出错。 继[62]之后,我们用精度、回忆和F1-分数来评估联系。 我们额外定义了相互作用质量的三个度量:穿透度,浮动距离,和指联对对象出错(MJ2O). 所有这三项评价都仅在GT机构与物体接触的框架中进行,因此在表格中按“接触”分类。 穿透和浮动距离分别测量了身体在物体网状上方的穿透或浮出多少. MJ2O测量在选定的正体关节上预测到的与对象网格的GT签名距离之间的错误. 对于ARCTIC来说,我们使用手接头和指尖,而对于BEHAVE来说,我们使用身体接头.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with prior works
blocks.zh: 4.2 与以往工程的比较

blocks.en: ARCTIC. We report the comparison with CARI4D [ 73 ] , InterTrack [ 72 ] and GraspHOI [ 23 ] on ARCTIC dataset in Table 1 . Note that this dataset is not used in training any methods hence it is an unseen test set. We report the contact metrics on hand vertices only as this dataset contains only hand interactions. InterTrack reconstructs human as SMPL-H and object as point clouds yet its inter-frame translation is inconsistent, leading to large errors. CARI4D is designed mainly for full body interaction without fingers, and we run it with SAM 3D Body as its human input. Nevertheless, its interaction module does not explicitly reason about fingers; hence the hand contact precision is much worse than ours. Furthermore, CARI4D struggles to reconstruct difficult viewpoints, as ARCTIC’s exocentric views are often at complicated angles, such as top-down views or bottom-up views. GraspHOI [ 23 ] is an image based optimization method which is slow (47.5 s per image); hence we compare with it only on key frames at 1fps. It reasons about hand articulation for object interaction, so the contact scores are better than CARI4D. Yet it struggles with hand occlusion and challenging viewpoints. Both GraspHOI and CARI4D try to pull the hand to the object, achieving high recall yet worse contact precision. In contrast, combined with our tracker, our coarse-to-fine refinement leads to the best result across all metrics. Notably, we reduce object Chamfer error by 56% and improve hand contact F1 from 0.866 to 0.921 compared to CARI4D. We also show some qualitative comparisons in Figure 3 .

blocks.en: ReachNet. We introduce ReachNet to reason about body and arm interaction with the object using geometric sensing and contact observation from images. We compare our ReachNet against GRAFT [ 83 ] ( Tab. 3 d) which refines body pose with a static scene, and also against our ReachNet trained without the image contact evidence ( Tab. 3 e). GRAFT is retrained on the same training data as ours and all four methods use the object pose from Tab. 3 row c. We can see that single-frame based GRAFT produces large human acceleration error and missing contacts, leading to large floating error at contact and much worse human-to-object error. The image contact evidence also substantially reduces hand floating from 4.23 mm to 1.60 mm, showing the advantage of combining 3D geometric sensing with contact observations. We propose to use two heads to predict body and arms separately. With a single head ( Tab. 3 f), the arm is less accurate, likely due to feature mixture and errors accumulated from pelvis to collar, causing shifts of the whole arm and hence worse penetration or floating.

blocks.en: Runtime comparison. We time each method end to end on ARCTIC sequences on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090. Our method takes 1.97 s per frame, compared with 4.83 s for CARI4D, 12.64 s for InterTrack and 47.5 s for GraspHOI, making it considerably faster than all baselines. All three baselines rely on test-time optimization: GraspHOI is fully optimization-based, while InterTrack and CARI4D spend 70% and 33% of their runtime in optimization. In contrast, ReachNet and TouchNet are feed-forward, so most of our runtime goes to foundation models.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented HARI4D, a category-agnostic method for metric 4D reconstruction of full-body human–object interactions with articulated hands from monocular RGB video. Following the natural hierarchy from whole-body approach to fine-grained grasp formation, our history-conditioned tracker stabilizes object motion under occlusion; ReachNet refines the body, arms, and wrists using local geometry, temporal context, and image-based contact evidence; and TouchNet reasons over the local object surface across time to refine wrist orientation and finger articulation. Experiments on ARCTIC and BEHAVE show improved reconstruction and interaction quality. On ARCTIC, unseen in training, HARI4D reduces object Chamfer distance by 56% and improves hand-contact F1 from 0.866 to 0.921 over CARI4D. It also applies to unseen objects and online videos. Our code and pretrained models will be released.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了HARI4D, 一种可知性方法, 按照从全身到精致地抓取形成的自然层次,我们历史所决定的追踪器在被封存下稳定了物体运动; ReachNet利用局部几何,时间背景,和以图像为基础的接触证据来精炼身体,手臂和手腕;以及 TouchNet在局部物体表面上跨时间的原因来精炼手腕取向和指纹. 关于ARCTIC和BEHAVE的实验显示,重建和互动的质量有所改善。 在ACTIC上,在训练中看不见,HARI4D将对象Chamfer相距缩短了56%,并在CARI4D上将手接相机F1从0.866提高到0.921. 它也适用于看不见的物体和在线视频. 我们的代码和预先训练过的模型将被释放.

blocks.en: Selecting the rest and contact frames. We identify stationary intervals by comparing each object mask with the masks one and five frames earlier and later. Within every stationary interval, candidate B B maximizes the visible object area away from the person, preferring frames whose contour is mostly free of the person and the image border. 6.2 Tracking Safeguards

blocks.en: Kalman seeding and stillness. The FoundationPose++ [ 75 ] filter state contains translation, Euler angles, and their velocities. At frame t t , the filter fuses the previous pose with a 2D anchor. The anchor is the point at the object’s previous depth on the camera ray through the center of the bounding box of M t o M^{o}_{t} , and it measures the lateral position of the object center. The filtered pose initializes two refiner iterations, which see the depth only inside M t o M^{o}_{t} . Additionally, a stationary object should not inherit depth noise. We therefore freeze its pose when the mask centroid moves by at most two pixels for at least two consecutive frames and the current mask overlaps the mask at the start of the hold with IoU at least 0.85. The filter is re-initialized on the frozen pose.

blocks.en: Contact-depth slide. A tracked object can drift along the camera ray, where monocular depth is least reliable. After each tracked frame, when all hands flagged in contact lie beyond a distance threshold from the object surface, measured from their SAM 3D Body [ 77 ] hand joints, we slide the object along the camera ray through its center, keeping its rotation and 2D projected position. Among log-spaced scalings of its camera distance, we take the one that brings the nearest flagged hand closest, apply it only if that hand then lies within the threshold, and keep it only if the IoU of Eq. 4 does not drop. The refiner and the filter then continue from the moved pose.

blocks.en: Occlusion fill. With a clip-wide sweep, poses with occlusion-aware IoU below 0.3 are replaced by interpolating rotation spherically and camera-frame translation linearly between the nearest kept poses, holding the nearest kept pose at the ends of the video. On this trajectory, we also flag a pose when the center of the tracked object lies more than an arm’s length behind the pelvis in depth, or when about 20% or less of the object pixels rendered at the previous tracked pose fall on M t o M^{o}_{t} . Flagged intervals separated by at most two frames are merged, and each interval must contain at least two consecutive flagged frames. Rotation is interpolated spherically between the trusted neighbors. We train on 7,200 frames from renderings of GRAB [ 52 ] training clips and 3,895 real frames from HO3D [ 17 ] sequences, with MoGe-3 depth shifted in each frame by its median difference from the ground-truth object depth over the visible object pixels. Each sample is drawn from GRAB with probability 0.6 and from HO3D with probability 0.4. As at test time, the refiner sees FoundationPose’s crop around the starting pose, with depth only inside the visible object mask. blocks.en: ReachNet. A frame holds 174 tokens. For each arm, 𝐅 a \mathbf{F}_{a} holds 56 tokens: the 21 hand joints, the shoulder, the elbow, a summary token, and 32 hand-surface samples. 𝐅 b \mathbf{F}_{b} holds 62 body tokens: 22 body joints, 32 body-surface samples, and 8 arm-surface patches. The geometry features of each token are mapped by an MLP to D = 256 D=256 and receive a learned embedding of the token type, and every token of hand s s also receives the contact embedding c t s ​ 𝐞 con c^{s}_{t}\mathbf{e}_{\mathrm{con}} . Three blocks, each with eight attention heads and a feed-forward width of 1024, apply temporal self-attention within a band of ± 45 \pm 45 frames with rotary position encoding, followed by spatial self-attention over all 174 tokens of the frame. blocks.en: ReachNet is trained on GRAB [ 52 ] and on the training sequences of BEHAVE [ 3 ] , where BEHAVE supervises only the body terms because its hand articulation is unavailable. The input body is obtained by running SAM 3D Body on the GRAB renderings and the BEHAVE training videos and converting it to SMPL-X. We transplant the root and body rotations of this estimate onto the ground-truth body, which keeps the ground-truth shape and pelvis translation, so the input preserves realistic estimator errors without introducing a shape mismatch. On GRAB, the input keeps the ground-truth finger articulation, which ReachNet does not change, as we want ReachNet to predict accurate wrist rotation. The HOI-DETR flags are computed on the same renderings and videos. The input object is the ground-truth object surface perturbed by temporally correlated noise, a rotation about a random axis and a translation along each axis, with stationary standard deviations of approximately 7 ∘ 7^{\circ} and 15 mm. The perturbed object trajectory is then smoothed over time by a Gaussian with a standard deviation of three frames. The perturbation magnitude is randomized per crop by a factor between 0.3 and 1.5, and 30% of crops additionally drop and refill object points. Arm and contact labels follow this perturbed object, while keeping the hand rigid, so that the hand contact stays faithful to the ground truth. This process is applied so that the network learns the interaction relative to the geometry it actually receives.

HOI-DETR旗被计算在同一渲染和视频上. 输入物体是地-真物体表面被时间相通的相通噪音所扰动,旋转大约一个随机轴并沿每个轴进行翻译,固定标准偏差约为7-Q 7-Circ}和15毫米. 被扰动的物体轨迹随时间推移被高斯人平滑,标准偏差为三帧. 扰动量按每作物0.3至1.5倍的因子随机分出,30%的作物会再降入并再填充物体点. 手臂和接触标签跟随这个被扰动的物体,同时使手保持刚性,使手接触保持对地上真实的忠诚. 这个过程被应用,以便网络学习相对于它实际得到的几何的交互.

blocks.en: ReachNet is trained from scratch for 37,500 steps with Adam. The learning rate warms linearly to 10 − 4 10^{-4} over 2,000 steps and decays cosinusoidally to 2 × 10 − 7 2\times 10^{-7} , and gradients are clipped at norm 1, separately for the body branch and for the remaining weights. Training uses one refinement iteration for the first 2,500 steps, two until step 5,000, and three afterwards, and the losses of all iterations are summed. Gradients are stopped between refinement iterations, so each iteration starts from the detached result of the previous one. Within an iteration, one pass of the shared network feeds both heads. The arm terms supervise the update of the arm head at the shoulder position before the body update, and re-attaching the arm to the moved shoulder is computed without gradient, while the contact term sees the root and body rotations detached. The arm, hand, and contact terms therefore train the shared network and the arm head, but not the body head. In each crop, the geometry features 𝐠 i \mathbf{g}_{i} of the shoulder and elbow anchors of each arm are zeroed with probability 0.35, so that the network relies less on the estimated arm position. Training crops contain at least 90 frames and at most 256 frames, and each step draws ⌊ 360 / T ⌋ \lfloor 360/T\rfloor crops of T T frames, with T = 90 T=90 with probability 0.75 and T T uniform in [ 91,256 ] [91,256] otherwise.

blocks.en: 6.5 TouchNet Training and Post-processing
blocks.zh: 6.5 触摸 净培训和后处理

blocks.en: TouchNet is trained on 90-frame windows from GRAB. Its coarse fingers are the SAM 3D Body estimate positioned at the ground-truth wrist, with the wrist rotation predicted by ReachNet. Visible finger rotations are moved along the geodesic from the SAM 3D Body estimate through the ground truth, occasionally overshooting the ground truth by up to 50% of that movement, so that excessive penetration or floating can be simulated. They also receive a random rotation of 12 ∘ 12^{\circ} RMS. We simulate hidden hands with probability 0.3 using a span whose length is geometrically distributed with a mean of nine frames and, with probability 0.15, an additional span of 30–90 frames. Frames that the hand visible flag marks as hidden on the renderings are hidden as well, and hidden frames receive interpolated fingers as at test time.

blocks.en: Finally, we remove isolated finger-rotation spikes. A frame is flagged as spiked when a joint rotates sharply away from both temporal neighbors up to three frames away, while those neighbors remain much closer to one another. All three joints of the affected finger are replaced over the spike by spherical interpolation, and detection and replacement run for up to three passes. If TouchNet lifts an already-contacting hand so that its nearest vertex floats more than 3 mm from the surface, we interpolate its wrist and finger rotations back toward the ReachNet pose until its nearest vertex lies just inside that distance. These rules use no ground truth and do not move the wrist position or object, and the last one acts on each hand and frame independently. On ARCTIC, the spike removal changes 127 of 103,510 frames (0.12%).
blocks.zh: 最后,我们移除了孤立的指向旋转钉. 当一个联合体从两个时空相邻区急剧旋转到三个相邻区时, 受影响指的三关节全部被球形插座所取代,并被检测和替换跑出最多3个出道口. 如果TouchNet举起已经接触过的手,使其最近的顶点从地表上浮出3毫米以上,我们插出它的手腕和指向RachNet的姿势回转,直到它的最近的顶点就在那个距离内. 这些规则没有使用地上真理,也不移动手腕位置或物体,最后一条则在每只手和相框上独立行动. 在ACTIC上,去除的尖峰值在103 510个帧中修改了127个(0.12%)。

blocks.en: Shared inputs and scoring. All methods read the same person and object masks. On BEHAVE, these are the masks released with the dataset, as in prior work [ 73 , 72 ] . On ARCTIC, all methods likewise receive the same object and person masks. All outputs are scored with the protocol of Sec. 4.1 . SMPL-H bodies, from the baselines and from the BEHAVE ground truth, are converted to SMPL-X with the deformation transfer released with SMPL-X [ 45 ] , followed by a per-frame fit. We use the Chamfer distance and acceleration error definitions of CARI4D [ 73 ] and the evaluation protocol of VisTracker [ 69 ] . Unlike CARI4D, which fits a single transformation to the first frame of each video, VisTracker fits it to all frames of each window, so that one unreliable frame cannot misalign an entire video.
blocks.zh: 分享投入和评分。 所有方法都读同一个人和物品口罩. 在BEHAVE上,这些是用数据集释放的口罩,如以前的工作[73,72]. 在ACTIC,所有方法都同样得到相同的物品和人口罩. 所有输出都与 Sec 的协议打分. 4.1 (中文(简体) ). SMPL-H体从基线和从BEHAVE地面真能转换为SMPL-X并用SMPL-X释放出变形转移,再由每帧相配. 我们使用 CARI4D [73] 的 Chamfer 距离和加速度错误定义以及 VisTracker [69] 的评价协议 。 与CARI4D不同,CARI4D与每个视频的第一个帧相匹配,VisTracker与每个窗口的所有帧相匹配,因此一个不可靠的帧不能给整个视频错配.

blocks.en: CARI4D. We run the official code with its released checkpoint. As the human input, we replace NLF [ 50 ] with SAM 3D Body [ 77 ] . On ARCTIC, we follow its pipeline for videos in the wild, while its FoundationPose tracking runs in both temporal directions as in its BEHAVE pipeline. Evaluation uses the same object meshes as ours, scaled by its own metric-scale estimation. On BEHAVE, we re-run its official BEHAVE pipeline, again with SAM 3D Body as the human input, using the object meshes, calibrated intrinsics, and 2D keypoints released by the CARI4D authors.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2016-03-29). CARI4D. 我们运行官方代码 及其释放的检查站。 作为人类输入,我们用SAM 3D Body [77] 代替 NLF [50]. 在ARCTIC上,我们跟随它在野外播放视频的管道,而它的"基础Pose"追踪则像它的"BEHAVE"的管道一样在时间方向上运行. 评价使用与我们相同的对象网格,按自己的尺度估计。 在BEHAVE上,我们重新运行其官方的BEHAVE管道,再次以SAM 3D body作为人类输入,使用对象网,校正内在,以及由CARI4D作者发布的2D键点.

blocks.en: InterTrack. We use the official code and released checkpoints without retraining. On ARCTIC, we run the authors’ InterCap script with translation estimated from 2D, after warping every frame and mask into the BEHAVE Kinect camera that InterTrack assumes, using the calibrated intrinsics of each view. We use its general reconstruction model, as ARCTIC’s objects are outside its chair-specific one, and the five-object pose network of that script. InterTrack reconstructs each frame up to scale, so before the window alignment we divide each frame by InterTrack’s estimated body scale. On BEHAVE, for Chamfer distance and acceleration, each frame is instead rescaled by the predicted human scale, as in the authors’ evaluation, before the same window alignment. As its object is a point cloud, the object Chamfer distance uses its points, penetration and MJ2O are undefined, and floating and contact use the distance from the hand or body vertices to the nearest object point.
blocks.zh: 间道. 我们使用官方代码 并释放检查站 没有再培训。 在 ARCTIC 上, 我们用 2D 估计的翻译来运行作者的 Intercap 脚本, 将每个相框和口罩打入 InterTrack 假设的 BEHAVE Kinect 相机, 并使用每个视图的校正内在内容。 我们使用它的一般重建模式,因为ACTIC的物体不在它主席专用的物体之外,而五个物体则构成这个文字的网络。 InterTrack将每个框架重建到规模,所以在窗口对齐之前,我们将每个框架按InterTrack的估计体积进行划分. 在BEHAVE,就Chamfer距离和加速度而言,每个帧都按照预测的人类尺度重新调整,如作者的评价,在同一窗口调整之前。 由于它的物体是点云,所以该物体Chamfer距离使用它的点,穿透和MJ2O是未定义的,而浮动和接触则使用从手或身体顶点到最近的物体点的距离.

blocks.en: GraspHOI. GraspHOI [ 23 ] optimizes single images, so we run it on the 1 fps samples of ARCTIC, every 30th frame of each video, skipping the dark first frame in 118 videos, for 3,382 frames in total. It reads our inputs: SAM 3D Body, the HOI-DETR detections, the masks, MoGe-3 depth and intrinsics. We score our method on the same 3,382 frames (Ours ∗ ). On these samples, each 300-frame window holds at most 10 samples and its alignment is fitted on them, and accelerations are taken between samples 1 s apart.
blocks.zh: 格拉斯普霍尔。 GraspHOI [23] 优化了单个图像,所以我们在ARCTIC的1 fps样本上运行,每段视频每30帧,跳过118个视频中的暗相第一帧,总共3,382帧. 它读取了我们的投入:SAM 三维体,HOI-DETR检测,口罩,MoGe-3深度和内在. 我们用同样的3 382个框架(我们的*)来评分我们的方法。 在这些样品上,每个300个框的窗口最多保存了10个样品,并安装在它们上,在1个样品之间进行加速度。

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: Heavy occlusions. When a hand stays heavily occluded by the object over a long span, SAM 3D Body has little evidence for it and often places it deep inside the object. ReachNet may then keep the hand close to this estimate, or move it only partway out, leaving the wrist away from its true position. TouchNet does not fix this either, as it refines the wrist orientation and the fingers around the wrist that ReachNet places and cannot pull out a hand that already penetrates deeply. Such hands can therefore remain inside the object over the whole occluded span. This happens only under very long and heavy occlusions as our temporal module can reason short occlusions from nearby frames. Recovering these hands under long occlusions would require more generative capability of the model, which we leave to future work.
blocks.zh: 重取诸相. 当一手长时间地被物体严重地占据后,SAM 3D body对此几乎没有证据,并经常将它放入物体深处. 到达 网会让手靠近这个估计,或者只将其部分移出,使手腕远离它的真实位置. 触摸 Net也没有解决这个问题,因为它改进了ReachNet所放置的手腕取向和手腕周围的手指,无法拔出已经深入的手. 因此,这种手可以在整个被包围的期间留在物体内。 只有在很长很重的隔离下才会发生 因为我们的时空舱可以解释附近框架的短隔离 在长期隔离下取回这些手需要模型的更能分基因的能力,我们留待未来工作。

blocks.en: Thin objects. TouchNet refines the fingers from the positions and normals of object surface samples near each joint. A thin object or part, such as a blade, a handle, or a sheet, offers only a few such samples around each finger, and their normals are less reliable, as the two sides of the part lie close together. With so little local geometry, TouchNet cannot reliably tell where the surface is or which side of it a finger is on, so fingers may float or pass through the part. One major reason is the training data, as most objects in GRAB, a common choice for learning hand–object interaction, are compact. Future work could learn such local grasps from more recent hand–object datasets with more thin objects, or from grasps simulated for robotic manipulation.
blocks.zh: 细物体. 触摸 网能从每个关节附近的物体表面样品的位置和常态上精炼出手指. 薄的物体或部分,如刀片,指柄,或被子等,每只指上只提供几个这样的样本,而它们的常态则不太可靠,因为部分的两侧相接相近. 由于局部几何学如此之少,TouchNet无法可靠地分辨出地表位置或指向的哪一侧,因此指会浮出或穿过部分. 其中一个主要原因是培训数据,因为GRAB中的多数对象(学习手-对象交互的共同选择)是紧凑的。 未来的工作可以从最近使用更薄物体的手-对象数据集或模拟机器人操纵的抓取中学习到这种局部把握。
